title: Water across a double bond
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: Acid-catalyzed hydration adds H and OH across propene. The OH group attaches to the more substituted middle carbon, producing 2-propanol.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of propene under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: Propene is treated with water and an acid catalyst. Which major organic product forms after workup? Acid-catalyzed hydration adds H and OH across propene. The OH group attaches to the more substituted middle carbon, producing 2-propanol.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
